en.title: Call of Duty Endowment Honors Veterans with Kyle Carpenter Valor Pack
en.summary: The Call of Duty Endowment is rolling out its Valor Pack to support veterans seeking employment, featuring exclusive in-game items tied to a Medal of Honor recipient's inspiring story. This initiative allows players to contribute directly to a crucial cause while celebrating military service.
en.body:
The **Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.)** is once again stepping up to support veterans transitioning to civilian careers, this time with a special push for its **Valor Pack**. Coinciding with Remembrance Day and Veterans Day, this in-game bundle offers players unique cosmetic items for **Modern Warfare 4** and **Warzone**, with a significant portion of proceeds directly funding employment assistance for former service members. The pack is a powerful reminder of the sacrifices made by those who have served, allowing the gaming community to contribute to a vital cause with every purchase.

At the heart of this year's Valor Pack is the story of Medal of Honor recipient and U.S. Marine Corps veteran **Kyle Carpenter**. The pack's design and thematic elements are deeply inspired by Carpenter's incredible journey, his act of valor, and his subsequent recovery. Players will find authentic details drawn from his military service, reflecting his resilience and the mantras that guided him. This personal connection makes the Valor Pack more than just a cosmetic set; it's a tribute to an individual's extraordinary courage and a symbol of the Endowment's mission to place veterans in meaningful jobs. For those looking to support the cause, the Valor Pack is available for purchase at www.callofduty.com/valor.

## Forging a Path to Employment

The Call of Duty Endowment has a long-standing commitment to helping veterans find stable, well-paying jobs. Since its inception, the organization has been instrumental in supporting thousands of veterans, exceeding its placement goals year after year. This year's Valor Pack push is particularly timely, highlighting how the gaming community can actively participate in this mission. The funds raised are crucial for C.O.D.E.'s operations, enabling them to partner with high-performing employment organizations that provide direct services to veterans. The success of these efforts is a testament to both the dedication of the Endowment staff and the generosity of the **Call of Duty** player base.

## A Community United in Support

This initiative resonates deeply within the **Call of Duty** community, a fanbase known for its passionate engagement and willingness to rally behind meaningful causes. The Valor Pack serves as a tangible way for players to honor veterans, many of whom are also part of this very community. Beyond the general availability of the pack, there's a special offering for veterans themselves. In collaboration with **USAA**, veterans can receive a free Valor Pack inspired by Kyle Carpenter's story, a thoughtful gesture recognizing their service and contributions. This combined effort underscores the broader impact that dedicated campaigns like this can have, fostering a sense of gratitude and collective action.

## What's Next

The Valor Pack is available now for players of **Modern Warfare 4** and **Warzone**. Further details on the specific impact of this year's fundraising efforts will be shared by the Call of Duty Endowment as they become available. Players are encouraged to visit the official **Call of Duty** Endowment website for more information on their programs and how to contribute.
